text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Should I proceed on the Triple Crown 
route, or pivot to the mile route...? Days 
went by without an answer. Then, one 
morning—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Here, drink slowly. Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came across Fuji Kiseki gently rubbing 
the back of an Umamusume who appeared to 
be a junior.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're usually bright and level-headed. 
You're not the type to push yourself to 
run without considering your physical 
limits, right?

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...What are you trying to say?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If something's troubling you, would you 
mind telling me about it? I really want to 
help you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You've been pushing yourself way too hard 
every morning lately, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking away from Fuji Kiseki's earnest 
eyes, she began to speak in a quiet voice.

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
………… Well then, allow me to speak without 
reservation.

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Must be nice for you, Fuji-senpai... 
Having the legs to take on the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Having to give up on even challenging 
them before you can even run... You could 
never understand that kind of 
frustration!"

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to aim for... the Nippon Derby 
too.

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
But—I can't run the full 2400 meters. With 
my legs, I wouldn't stand a chance.

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Of course, there are many other 
wonderful races besides the Derby."

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"So I know it's best to compete at the 
distance I'm best at, the Mile. But...!"

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's been my dream ever since I was 
little. I promised my family that someday, 
I'd become a splendid Derby Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
............ This is... the reason I was 
pushing myself so hard to run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that whisper, the dark bay Umamusume 
turned and darted away as if fleeing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Trainer. Oh dear, you saw that, 
did you?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm okay, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"She was backed into a corner, too. I'll 
find the right time to back her up."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—Well, playing it cool is all well and 
good, but... what in the world should I do 
now? Mister Hollow in the Tree.”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(...I couldn't offer a single word of 
comfort. Her words were just too 
heartfelt...)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The stage known as the Nippon Derby shines 
far too bright. A royal road pursued with 
longing, yearning, and betting one's very 
life.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Just because you can't aim for that 
stage doesn't mean you lack ability. 
But――"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The frustration, the sheer despair of 
yearning for it yet not even being allowed 
to try—words can hardly express it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still... She has her own path to follow, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There is a path where she can run with her 
head held high, heart dancing, and 
believing in the future. Without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
There isn't just one path, broaden your 
perspective.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"You must strive for heights that only you 
can reach."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(...I painfully understand how you felt 
back then now, Mom.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Alright...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Steel your resolve, "Fuji Kiseki"...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after that happened—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Got a second? I want to talk about 
changing my racing plans!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Do you remember when we talked about 
whether to take the Triple Crown route or 
the mile route?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to add one more crucial criterion 
for choosing that!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember that girl from the other 
day? That little pony who ran away crying.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As you know, Trainer, distance aptitudes 
are an issue that constantly dogs an 
Umamusume. Many have had their dreams 
crushed by it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, I'm not suited for long 
distances either. I understand how she 
feels. But that's exactly why—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I might even be able to shoulder her 
future too! In the upcoming Japan Derby 
and Kikuka Sho...!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If I perform well on the Triple Crown 
route, that girl might be able to dive 
into the Derby without fear!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If I can make a splash on the mile route, 
it might make challenging the mile truly 
thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to be the one to create her 
light...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Anxieties about the future, the 
bitterness of broken dreams, I'll blow 
them all away together with my miracle!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Please don't tell me it's reckless.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As the entertainer "Fuji Kiseki," I cannot 
overlook a single tear from any of my 
ponies.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though her tone is lighthearted, Fuji 
Kiseki seems to have made an extraordinary 
resolution...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The stage is set. Now, why don't we 
re-evaluate our path?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then I must give this careful thought and 
make my decision with full resolve. The 
Triple Crown route, or the Mile route—!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The target race has been set to the 
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, got it! Thank you for believing in 
me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's prepare for the press 
conference right away! We have to warm up 
the audience, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki's confession about her 
distance aptitude sent ripples of shock 
through the press conference.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
You mean the distance of the Japan Derby 
and Kikuka Sho would be too tough? Does 
that mean she'll change routes...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
It's basically like the Classic Triple 
Crown front lost its main star. Man, 
things might get wild...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The protagonist remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Fuji Kiseki's dignified voice echoed 
through the bustling press conference 
hall."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because of this aptitude 
that I want to challenge the Triple Crown 
route. With these legs, I want to prove I 
can conquer the remaining 2,400m and 
3,000m!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...It might be a reckless path. 2,400 
meters is one thing, but 3,000 meters 
might be completely out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And yet—that's precisely why it's so 
thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Can Fuji Kiseki truly conquer that grand 
stage?" I can already see the headlines! 
And that is why everyone wishes for it 
more fervently than ever!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"‘Oh Fuji Kiseki, please, show us a 
miracle!’—like that!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"This is a show, a challenge, and a matter 
of pride dedicated to you and my beloved 
junior."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Fuji Kiseki said at the press 
conference spread throughout the world in 
the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that press conference? It's 
pretty amazing, taking on a distance she's 
not suited for.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Right? But you know, I wonder why... Even 
so, I just feel like Fuji Kiseki can pull 
it off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume scene reaches an even higher 
fever pitch. —The next race is the 
Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Target race changed to the NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, got it! You believed in me, and I 
promise I'll live up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's hold a press conference 
right away! Now then, how should we 
announce this major upset—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki's confession about her 
distance aptitude sent ripples of shock 
through the press conference.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"So you mean you're not running in the 
Nippon Derby? Aw, I was really looking 
forward to it..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
It's basically like the Classic Triple 
Crown front lost its main star. Man, 
things might get wild...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, from now on—I shall put on a 
dazzling show in the mile division!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Fuji Kiseki's dignified voice echoed 
through the bustling press conference 
hall."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Depending on the actors who take the 
stage, a performance can become infinitely 
more fascinating!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In other words—no matter the race, it is 
the Umamusume who create the brilliance 
within it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even without the pinnacle of glory to be 
found there, our brilliance shall surely 
captivate you all!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Please look forward to the miraculous tale 
that will be spun along the mile route...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those words, her body was enveloped 
in a smokescreen—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: By the time I noticed, it had disappeared.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The press conference, which felt like a 
scene straight out of a show, spread 
throughout the world in the blink of an 
eye."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
D-Did you see it!? That press conference 
where Fuji-sama disappeared! Word is she's 
changing her career path...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member B
text_block_list.text:
"I saw it~! I was a bit startled, but that 
just means we get to see Lord Fuji's true 
brilliance, right~?!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup, that's right~~! I'm just so, so 
looking forward to it~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume scene reaches an even higher 
fever pitch. —Next up is the NHK Mile Cup!
